model_evidence.basis: Only the supplied Bing live_retrieval_evidence was evaluated.
model_evidence.conclusion: Discovery is complete, but no retrieved URL exposes both a real job listing or API and a direct QA/testing vacancy card for Berlin, Leipzig, Dresden, or explicitly Germany-wide remote. No new source meets the addition criteria.

findings.result: Unrelated restaurant, event-location, and local-business pages; no vacancy listing, recruiting API, or QA/test job card.
Encyclopedia and quality-management informational pages; no Dresden vacancy card or searchable job source.
Online gaming and game-retail sites rather than recruiting sources; no Leipzig game-QA vacancy card.
Technical articles and educational material; no recruiting API or Germany-wide remote QA/test vacancy card.
QA definitions, training information, and general articles; no concrete current German QA vacancy card.
